title: Partner Account Executive
teaser: Become part of our team as a Partner Account Executive, leading engagement and revenue growth for Cisco in the West Region. Drive joint go-to-market strategies and expand Cisco’s presence through strong partner relationships. Ideal for experienced channel leaders with a growth mindset and expertise in IT partner ecosystems.
description:
Partner Account Executive (PAE) to lead engagement and revenue growth across Growth Partners in the West Region. This role is responsible for driving joint go-to-market strategies, accelerating partner-led sales, and expanding Cisco’s footprint through strong partner relationships.

The ideal candidate will bring strong channel experience, a growth mindset, and the ability to influence at all levels within partner organizations and form a bridge between Cisco Sales account teams and partners.

Key responsibilities:

 • Drive outstanding Y/Y partner revenue growth.

 • Lead existing relationships across all levels of your partner organization. Generate enthusiasm and passion for Cisco products among partner teams.

 • Build and maintain business plans. Deliver sales and technical trainings for partners.

 • Facilitate communications and deal flow between partner and Cisco sales.

 • Leverage competitive knowledge to position Cisco effectively within the partner landscape and differentiate our solutions from competitors.

Minimum Qualifications:

 • Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience working with channel partners in the IT industry, with strong understanding of the India (West region) partner ecosystem.

 • Strong understanding of the IT ecosystem and indirect sales models.

 • Proven track record of exceeding revenue targets.

 • Experience managing regional territories and partner portfolios.

 • Excellent executive presence, communication, and negotiation skills.

 Preferred:

 • Knowledge of Cisco solutions and partner programs.

 • Experience in networking, cybersecurity, cloud, or SaaS technologies.

 • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, or related field
